camel_example: aliyun hbr DescribeBackupPlans --region cn-hangzhou --Filters.1.Key vaultId --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SourceType ECS_FILE --Filters.1.Values.1 'v-000000000000000000000' --Edition STANDARD
description_en: Gets one or more backup plans that meet specified conditions
description_zh: 获取一个或者多个符合条件的备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-backup-plans --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-type ECS_FILE --filters '[{"Values":["v-000000000000000000000"],"Key":"vaultId"}]' --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupPlans

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **ECS\_FILE**: Files of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

- **OSS**: Objects in Object Storage Service (OSS).

- **NAS**: File systems of Apsara File Storage NAS (NAS).

- **OTS**: Tablestore instances.

- **UDM\_ECS**: Entire ECS instances.

- **SYNC**: Data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

- **ECS_FILE**：备份ECS文件
- **OSS**：备份阿里云OSS
- **NAS**：备份阿里云NAS
- **OTS**：备份阿里云表格存储
- **UDM_ECS**：备份阿里云ECS整机
- **SYNC**：数据同步
parameters.name: source_type

element_fields.help_en:
The key in the filter. Valid values:

- **regionId**: The region ID.

- **planId**: The ID of the backup plan.

- **sourceType**: The type of the backup source.

- **vaultId**: The ID of the backup repository.

- **instanceName**: The name of the instance.

- **instanceId**: The ID of the instance.

- **planName**: The name of the backup plan
element_fields.help_zh:
查询过滤器中的键值。取值可包括：

- **regionId**：地域ID
- **planId**：计划ID
- **sourceType**：备份源类型
- **vaultId**：仓库ID
- **instanceName**：实例名称
- **instanceId**：实例ID
- **planName**：计划名称
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value to match in the filter
element_fields.help_zh: 查询过滤器中的待匹配的值
element_fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The edition of the backup plan. Valid values: BASIC and STANDARD. Default value: STANDARD
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition
